proposals.evidence: DEDR4867 gives Tamil miḷaku, Malayalam miḷaku/muḷaku pepper, Kota meḷg chilli and Kodagu maḷu chillies. These southern survey forms preserve the pepper-to-chilli lexical extension explicitly attested within the family; the source chilli gloss is not changed to black pepper. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR183 explicitly gives Irula amme father, Tulu amme father and Gondi amma/ammal father within the amma kin-term family. Betta Kurumba amman and Urali ammɛ father compare with that attested paternal use; the source father gloss is preserved rather than changed to mother. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR3098 gives Tamil/Malayalam tar-/tār-, imperative tā, past tant-/tann-, and Badaga/Kota corresponding give stems. Survey bare tā/taru and Urali tant- forms retain that give family and ordinary inflection. Perfect responses containing an unresolved additional stem are excluded. The paired elicitation gloss is retained even where this individual source record contains only the bare/imperative or inflected verb; no absent clause is reconstructed. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
